propositions: Schema fields in _config_schema.py may exist with zero read sites in application code, causing configuration knobs to silently have no effect.
Current detection gates cover environment variable drift but lack equivalent coverage for schema-defined configuration fields.
An AST-level deterministic check is needed to enforce that every _config_schema.py field has at least one attribute-read site outside schema/config plumbing modules.

The check matches ast.Attribute nodes in Load context by terminal field name, accepting all read shapes (direct config access, section objects, self.config chains) while remaining permissive to same-named attributes across unrelated objects.
Fields with no read sites must either gain a read site or receive a '# read-via: <pointer>' comment explaining indirect reads, with bare markers rejected.
The check fires only on zero references, avoiding false positives during refactors that move or rename reads.
